results.title: Badgers rally past No. 10 Garden City in season opener
results.description: EPHRAIM—The Snow College Badgers opened the 2026 football season with a 31-17 victory over No. 10 Garden City Community College (Kansas) on Saturday in Ephraim, proving the Broncbusters truly weren’t in Kansas anymore.
